title: Oven Roasted Filipino Okra Stew
description: Fresh, crunchy okra roasted with garlic, tomatoes, and a sweet vinegar glaze that evokes nostalgic Filipino flavor in one pan.
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 F (220 C) and line a slate tile baking sheet with parchment paper.
Toss the trimmed okra in olive oil, minced garlic, sea salt, and black pepper until evenly coated.
Spread the seasoned okra in a single layer on the prepared baking sheet.
Roast for 15 minutes, or until the edges start to brown.
Remove the sheet from the oven and add halved cherry tomatoes and sliced bell pepper to the pan.
Drizzle rice vinegar and sprinkle coconut sugar over the vegetables, then stir to combine.
Return the pan to the oven and roast for an additional 10 minutes, or until all vegetables are tender and slightly caramelized.
Transfer the stew to a serving dish and serve hot, optionally garnished with fresh herbs.
